description: Find local sports stores (soccer stores today) by name, chain, town, state or distance, with address, phone, brands and whether they outfit teams. Each result has the store's org_key for get_store and the link tools.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous answer, for the next page of the same search.

near.description: A 5-digit US ZIP code, or latitude,longitude, to search by distance. Results then carry distance_mi.

query.description: Store name, chain or town. Every word must match; when nothing does, similar names come back as candidates.

state.description: Two-letter US state code, for example OH or PA.

team_dealer.description: true: only stores that outfit teams (uniforms for clubs).

name: search_stores
title: Search sports stores
